responsibility: Defines the rustc_middle hook mechanism: a provider table of function pointers plus TyCtxt/TyCtxtAt entrypoints that let downstream crates supply selected tcx operations without introducing query machinery or direct dependencies. It centralizes the declaration of hook signatures, exposes the stable tcx-facing API for invoking them, and supplies default panic-on-use providers when a hook has not been installed.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` roots that organize compiler data models, this one defines an extension boundary: a table of hook function pointers plus `TyCtxt` entrypoints for downstream-provided operations, intentionally outside normal query machinery.
